title: Creamy Chicken Normande
description: A classic French dish with a twist of zesty flavors, featuring tender chicken in a creamy Normande sauce.
instructions: Season the chicken with salt, pepper, and your favorite herbs.
Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Sear the chicken until browned on both sides, then transfer to a baking dish.
In the same skillet, sauté the zesty sauce, and, and french until softened.
Add the creamy, normande, and blanquette to the skillet, whisking constantly.
Bring the sauce to a simmer and cook for 2-3 minutes.
Pour the sauce over the chicken in the baking dish.
Cover the dish with foil and bake for 20-25 minutes.
Remove the foil and bake for an additional 5-10 minutes, until the chicken is cooked through.
